public_rationale: Bloomberg reported on February 24, 2025 that TD Cowen identified canceled US leases totaling “a couple of hundred megawatts” and reduced conversion of preliminary agreements into leases [e1]. Bisnow's March 27 report cited a March 26 estimate of 2 GW of abandoned pending leases over six months [e2]. That period extends beyond March 3, and the report does not separate withdrawals before and after that date [e2]. The April 28 account described the 2 GW as nonbinding letters of intent without establishing when all the withdrawals occurred [e3]. These reports establish neither a total substantially above 1 GW by March 3 with duplicate projects excluded nor an upper bound that contradicts the claim [e1, e2, e3].
limitations: The reports lack project dates and capacity figures sufficient to exclude duplicate counting and distinguish abandonment from temporary delays [e1, e2, e3].
The later 2 GW estimate cannot be assigned wholly to the period ending March 3, 2025 [e2, e3].
The original TD Cowen research was not obtained.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: The realistic amount of data center expansion Microsoft canceled is much higher than a gigawatt.

statement.excerpt: And, again, this is the most conservative estimate. The realistic number is much, much higher.

from_speaker: Microsoft canceling over a gigawatt of data center expansion
The realistic number is much, much higher.
our_interpretation: The plain reading is that the capacity Microsoft had already abandoned substantially exceeded one gigawatt by March 3, 2025.

The surrounding post includes canceled leases, expired letters of intent, abandoned negotiations and land deals. The claim therefore concerns abandoned planned capacity, not exclusively terminated binding leases.
The target is the cumulative abandonment described as of publication. Its beginning is unspecified; no arbitrary starting date is imposed.
Substantially higher requires a material excess over one gigawatt. The speaker supplied no numerical multiplier.
Later reporting can establish earlier cancellations, but cancellations occurring after publication cannot establish this observation.
criteria.support_condition: Credible reporting or project records establish a nonduplicated total of abandoned planned capacity substantially above one gigawatt by March 3, 2025.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A sufficiently comprehensive accounting establishes that the abandoned capacity by March 3, 2025 was at or below one gigawatt, or exceeded it only marginally.

Bisnow reports a March 26 analyst estimate of two gigawatts of abandoned pending leases over six months, alongside recent deferrals and cancellations. The reporting window extends beyond March 3 and does not allocate the two-gigawatt total between earlier and later decisions.

public_payload.what_would_resolve: A comprehensive project inventory would need to establish capacity abandoned by March 3, 2025, exclude duplicate counting, and separate abandonment from delays.
